The Championship 26–27 Finals for the ONE PIECE Card Game will crown each region’s Card Game Pirate King and determine who advances to the World Championship 26–27 in Japan.

For North America, Europe, and Latin America, there will be two Finals tournaments this year: Season 1 in August and September 2026, and Season 2 in January 2027. If a BANDAI CARD GAMES Fest happens to be taking place around the same time and place as a Finals event, the Finals will be hosted there.
Players who qualify for the World Championship should ensure they have a valid passport and apply for a visa, if necessary, as soon as event dates and their participation are confirmed.
*Finals tournaments in North America and Europe require an invite, which must be earned at a Regional event.
*Invites from Season 1 Regionals are valid only for Season 1 Finals, and invites from Season 2 Regionals are valid only for Season 2 Finals.
*Invited players will be automatically pre-registered on BANDAI TCG+ and will receive a payment code. To participate, please complete payment and submit your deck list by the specified deadline.
*Finals tournaments in Oceania and Latin America do not require an invite.

*Players may participate in events outside their region; however, they must reside in a region to represent it at the World Championship. If a non-resident wins a Championship Finals event, the World Championship invitation will be awarded to the next highest-ranking resident of that region.
*Prize structures and amounts may vary by region.
